lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Y8O24 (reduced formula SrY4O12) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 34 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Y centers in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors, while O centers adopt either a tetrahedral (two Y neighbors) or square-pyramidal (two O, three Y neighbors) environment; Sr centers are coordinated by 12 O neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 34 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between O tetrahedra and Y octahedra, edge-sharing between Y octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between O square pyramids.
